## Rational functions

How rational functions are represented in `pyrat`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [JuliaRatfun](JuliaRatfun.qmd#pyrat.JuliaRatfun) | Python wrapper for Julia rational functions. |
| [JuliaRatinterp](JuliaRatinterp.qmd#pyrat.JuliaRatinterp) | Python wrapper for Julia rational interpolants. |
| [Bary](Bary.qmd#pyrat.Bary) | Barycentric rational interpolant. |

Rational approximations over domains.

| --- | --- |
| [JuliaApprox](JuliaApprox.qmd#pyrat.JuliaApprox) | Base class for rational function approximations. |
| [ContinuumApprox](ContinuumApprox.qmd#pyrat.ContinuumApprox) | Rational approximation on a continuum domain. |
